title: Line sketch: Sunset Reflections on Wet Highway
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: The composition shows a futuristic city at sunset with two cars driving on a glossy, rain-slicked highway that stretches toward a glowing horizon. A massive sun dominates the fiery sky above silhouetted skyscrapers, their reflections shimmering on the wet pavement. Bold, sweeping and vibrant color blending emphasize the dramatic perspective and luminous atmosphere (derived from painting #93).
